notes:
Summary: Large payments analytics platform; high-risk production workloads (fraud, regulation). Primary interest in Redwood Dedicated with VPC + optional on-prem node for sensitive flows. Evaluation focused on throughput guarantees and per-model tuning.

Workload & targets (from SE discovery):
- Workload types: conversational support agents (chat with history), embeddings for nearline search/reranking, batch reranking for transaction scoring.
- Latency SLO targets: chat p50 < 60ms (short context), p95 < 200ms (8k); for long-context (32k) p95 target relaxed to < 400ms. Reranking/embeddings throughput target: sustained 150-250 QPS, bursts to 400 QPS for 1–3 minutes.
- Availability target: 99.95% platform uptime for dedicated pool; credits model required for missed SLOs.

Model-specific tuning asks:
- Context length: primary models evaluated at 8k and 32k. Need advice on dynamic context windowing and prefix eviction for long customer threads.
- Quantization: NBFA will accept int8 for most scoring models but requires fallback FP16 for regulatory explanations. Want Redwood to recommend quantization profiles per-model (int8/4/FP16 tradeoffs) and validation harness.
- Batching/KV cache: aggressive continuous batching for embeddings, but chat needs low-latency micro-batches + per-account KV cache pinned for 4 hours TTL to speed re-entrant sessions. Concern about KV-cache memory growth and eviction policy.
- Reserved GPU planning: recommended baseline 6–8 H100-equivalent GPUs for initial rollout; run capacity planning scenarios (sustained vs burst) with explicit pre-warm rules.

SLA / procurement notes:
- Legal: add data residency clause (EU/NA segmentation) and encryption-at-rest proof (customer KMS).
- SLA negotiation items: guaranteed throughput baseline, burst guarantees, scheduled maintenance windows, 24x7 escalation, credit formula for p95/p99 misses.
- Pricing: they prefer a blended reserved + usage overlay. Want 12-month term options with quarterly capacity review.

Artifacts to deliver: dedicated perf run (4x H100 and 8x A100 profiles), quantization impact report, KV-cache sizing worksheet, draft SLA with explicit SLO table and credits example.

Direct quotes / snippets: "We cannot accept silent degradations — need a hard p95 number tied to credits." — Head of ML Ops.

CRM shorthand: POC runway 6–8 weeks. High procurement friction (legal + security). Priority: stability over lowest cost.
